copyPanel.formula: Surface Area = Sum of areas of all 6 faces
steps: 1. Calculate area of Top & Bottom: 2 × (l · w)
2. Calculate area of Front & Back: 2 × (l · h)
3. Calculate area of Left & Right: 2 × (w · h), then sum all three pairs

revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Painting a Bedroom
revealWordProblem.text: Tahira is planning to paint the walls of her bedroom, which is in the shape of a rectangular prism 12 ft long, 10 ft wide, and 8 ft tall. She will not paint the floor or ceiling. The room has one window (3 ft by 4 ft) and two doors (each 3 ft by 7 ft) that will not be painted. How many square feet of wall does Tahira need to paint?
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: Wall area = perimeter × height = 2(12 + 10) × 8 = 44 × 8 = 352 ft². Subtract the openings: window = 3 × 4 = 12 ft²; two doors = 2 × (3 × 7) = 42 ft². Paintable area = 352 − 12 − 42 = 298 ft².

questions.stem: A time capsule is a rectangular prism with l = 5 cm, w = 4 cm, h = 3 cm. What surface area needs paint?
choiceFeedback: You found half the faces — remember each face has a matching opposite face to double.
That's the volume — surface area adds up all six face areas instead of multiplying three edges.
Check the units — a surface measurement needs square units, not cubic.
hints: You need surface area — the total of all 6 face areas of the 5 × 4 × 3 prism — not the space inside.
Use SA = 2lw + 2lh + 2wh: three different faces, each with a matching twin on the opposite side.
Find the three face areas first: 5×4 = 20, 5×3 = 15, and 4×3 = 12. Double each, then add the results.
questions.stemEs: Una cápsula del tiempo es un prisma rectangular con l = 5 cm, w = 4 cm, h = 3 cm. ¿Qué área de superficie hay que pintar?
hintsEs: Necesitas el área superficial: el total de las 6 áreas de cara del prisma de 5 × 4 × 3, no el espacio de adentro.
Usa AS = 2la + 2lh + 2ah: tres caras distintas, cada una con su gemela en el lado opuesto.
Halla primero las tres áreas de cara: 5×4 = 20, 5×3 = 15 y 4×3 = 12. Duplica cada una y luego suma los resultados.

questions.stem: How many faces does a triangular prism have?
questions.explanation: A triangular prism has 5 faces: 2 triangular bases and 3 rectangular lateral faces.
choiceFeedback: That's just the rectangular sides — don't forget the two triangular ends.
Count again — a triangular prism has more rectangular sides than that, plus its two ends.
That's the face count for a rectangular prism — a triangular prism has one fewer face.
hints: Picture a tent or a triangular chocolate box: two triangle ends plus rectangles wrapping around the sides.
Count the two triangular bases first, then count one rectangle for each side of the triangle.
A triangle has 3 sides, so count 3 rectangular faces. Then add the triangular ends to that count.
questions.explanationEs: Un prisma triangular tiene 5 caras: 2 bases triangulares y 3 caras laterales rectangulares.
hintsEs: Imagina una tienda de campaña o una caja triangular de chocolates: dos extremos triangulares más rectángulos que envuelven los lados.
Cuenta primero las dos bases triangulares y luego cuenta un rectángulo por cada lado del triángulo.
Un triángulo tiene 3 lados, así que cuenta 3 caras rectangulares. Luego suma los extremos triangulares a ese conteo.

questions.stem: A wedge-shaped time capsule is a triangular prism. It has two triangular bases each with area 12 cm² and three rectangular faces with areas 30 cm², 40 cm², and 40 cm². What is the total surface area to paint?
choiceFeedback: You added the three rectangles but left out both triangular bases.
You included only one triangular base — a prism has two matching triangular ends to add.
Check the units — surface area is measured in square units, not cubic.
hints: All five face areas are given: two triangles of 12 cm² each, and rectangles of 30, 40, and 40 cm².
Total surface area = every face added once — count BOTH triangular bases, not just one.
Start with the triangles: 2 × 12 = 24 cm². Then add the three rectangle areas to that.
questions.stemEs: Una cápsula del tiempo en forma de cuña es un prisma triangular. Tiene dos bases triangulares, cada una con un área de 12 cm², y tres caras rectangulares con áreas de 30 cm², 40 cm² y 40 cm². ¿Cuál es el área de superficie total que hay que pintar?
hintsEs: Te dan las cinco áreas de cara: dos triángulos de 12 cm² cada uno y rectángulos de 30, 40 y 40 cm².
Área superficial total = cada cara sumada una vez; cuenta AMBAS bases triangulares, no solo una.
Empieza con los triángulos: 2 × 12 = 24 cm². Luego súmale las tres áreas de los rectángulos.

reviewHighlights.formula: Surface Area = Sum of areas of all 6 faces
steps: 1. Calculate area of Top & Bottom: 2 × (l · w)
2. Calculate area of Front & Back: 2 × (l · h)
3. Calculate area of Left & Right: 2 × (w · h), then sum all three pairs
reviewHighlights.watchOut: A common mistake in Surface Area of Prisms is confusing surface area with volume — multiplying l × w × h (which finds the space INSIDE the prism, in cubic units) instead of adding the areas of all the faces (SA = 2lw + 2lh + 2wh, in square units). A second common slip is forgetting to double one face pair, like writing 2(l×w) + 2(l×h) + (w×h) instead of + 2(w×h) — always count all 6 faces (or all 5 for a triangular prism) before you submit.

level1.stem: A rectangular prism is 6 in long, 2 in wide, and 1 in tall. Find its surface area.
level1.stemEs: Un prisma rectangular mide 6 pulg de largo, 2 pulg de ancho y 1 pulg de alto. Halla su área de superficie.
hints: Find each pair of matching faces. Then add.
hintsEs: Halla cada par de caras iguales. Luego suma.
level1.explanation: Find each pair of faces: 2 × (6 × 2) = 24; 2 × (6 × 1) = 12; 2 × (2 × 1) = 4 Add the three pairs: 24 + 12 + 4 = 40
level1.explanationEs: Halla cada par de caras: 2 × (6 × 2) = 24; 2 × (6 × 1) = 12; 2 × (2 × 1) = 4 Suma los tres pares: 24 + 12 + 4 = 40

level1.stem: A triangular prism is 2 cm long. Each triangle end has a base of 12 cm and a height of 8 cm. The slanted sides are 10 cm. Find the surface area.
level1.stemEs: Un prisma triangular mide 2 cm de largo. Cada triángulo de los extremos tiene una base de 12 cm y una altura de 8 cm. Los lados inclinados miden 10 cm. Halla el área de superficie.
hints: Find the 2 triangles. Then find the 3 rectangles. Add all 5 faces.
hintsEs: Halla los 2 triángulos. Luego halla los 3 rectángulos. Suma las 5 caras.
level1.explanation: Find the two triangles: 1/2 × 12 × 8 = 48; 2 × 48 = 96 Find the three rectangles: 12 × 2 = 24; 10 × 2 = 20; 10 × 2 = 20 Add all five faces: 96 + 24 + 20 + 20 = 160
level1.explanationEs: Halla los dos triángulos: 1/2 × 12 × 8 = 48; 2 × 48 = 96 Halla los tres rectángulos: 12 × 2 = 24; 10 × 2 = 20; 10 × 2 = 20 Suma las cinco caras: 96 + 24 + 20 + 20 = 160

level1.stem: A triangular prism is 3 in long. Its triangle ends have sides of 6 in, 8 in and 10 in. The 6 in and 8 in sides meet at a square corner. Find the surface area.
level1.stemEs: Un prisma triangular mide 3 pulg de largo. Sus triángulos de los extremos tienen lados de 6 pulg, 8 pulg y 10 pulg. Los lados de 6 pulg y 8 pulg forman una esquina cuadrada. Halla el área de superficie.
hints: The sides at the square corner are the base and height of the triangle.
hintsEs: Los lados de la esquina cuadrada son la base y la altura del triángulo.
level1.explanation: Find the two triangles: 1/2 × 6 × 8 = 24; 2 × 24 = 48 Find the three rectangles: 6 × 3 = 18; 8 × 3 = 24; 10 × 3 = 30 Add all five faces: 48 + 18 + 24 + 30 = 120
level1.explanationEs: Halla los dos triángulos: 1/2 × 6 × 8 = 24; 2 × 24 = 48 Halla los tres rectángulos: 6 × 3 = 18; 8 × 3 = 24; 10 × 3 = 30 Suma las cinco caras: 48 + 18 + 24 + 30 = 120

level1.stem: A rectangular prism is 4 cm long, 2 cm wide, and 1 cm tall. Find its surface area.
level1.stemEs: Un prisma rectangular mide 4 cm de largo, 2 cm de ancho y 1 cm de alto. Halla su área de superficie.
hints: A rectangular prism has 3 pairs of matching faces. Find each pair, then add.
hintsEs: Un prisma rectangular tiene 3 pares de caras iguales. Halla cada par y luego suma.
level1.explanation: Find each pair of faces: 2 × (4 × 2) = 16; 2 × (4 × 1) = 8; 2 × (2 × 1) = 4 Add the three pairs: 16 + 8 + 4 = 28
level1.explanationEs: Halla cada par de caras: 2 × (4 × 2) = 16; 2 × (4 × 1) = 8; 2 × (2 × 1) = 4 Suma los tres pares: 16 + 8 + 4 = 28

level1.stem: A triangular prism is 10 cm long. Its triangle ends have sides of 8 cm, 15 cm and 17 cm. The 8 cm and 15 cm sides meet at a square corner. Find the surface area.
level1.stemEs: Un prisma triangular mide 10 cm de largo. Sus triángulos de los extremos tienen lados de 8 cm, 15 cm y 17 cm. Los lados de 8 cm y 15 cm forman una esquina cuadrada. Halla el área de superficie.
hints: Use the two sides at the square corner for the triangles. Use all three sides for the rectangles.
hintsEs: Usa los dos lados de la esquina cuadrada para los triángulos. Usa los tres lados para los rectángulos.
level1.explanation: Find the two triangles: 1/2 × 8 × 15 = 60; 2 × 60 = 120 Find the three rectangles: 8 × 10 = 80; 15 × 10 = 150; 17 × 10 = 170 Add all five faces: 120 + 80 + 150 + 170 = 520
level1.explanationEs: Halla los dos triángulos: 1/2 × 8 × 15 = 60; 2 × 60 = 120 Halla los tres rectángulos: 8 × 10 = 80; 15 × 10 = 150; 17 × 10 = 170 Suma las cinco caras: 120 + 80 + 150 + 170 = 520

level2.stem: Rosa finds the surface area of a triangular prism. The rectangles are 12, 16 and 20 square inches. Each triangle end is 24 square inches. She adds 12 + 16 + 20 + 24 = 72. What is the correct surface area?
level2.stemEs: Rosa halla el área de superficie de un prisma triangular. Los rectángulos miden 12, 16 y 20 pulgadas cuadradas. Cada triángulo de los extremos mide 24 pulgadas cuadradas. Ella suma 12 + 16 + 20 + 24 = 72. ¿Cuál es el área de superficie correcta?
hints: Count the faces Rosa added. How many faces does a triangular prism have?
hintsEs: Cuenta las caras que sumó Rosa. ¿Cuántas caras tiene un prisma triangular?
level2.explanation: Count the faces Rosa added: 4 faces, not 5 Add the missing triangle end: 72 + 24 = 96
level2.explanationEs: Cuenta las caras que sumó Rosa: 4 caras, no 5 Suma el triángulo que falta: 72 + 24 = 96

level2.stem: A triangular prism is 2.5 cm long. Each triangle end has a base of 16 cm and a height of 15 cm. The slanted sides are 17 cm. Find the surface area.
level2.stemEs: Un prisma triangular mide 2.5 cm de largo. Cada triángulo de los extremos tiene una base de 16 cm y una altura de 15 cm. Los lados inclinados miden 17 cm. Halla el área de superficie.
hints: The perimeter of the triangle times the length gives all three rectangles.
hintsEs: El perímetro del triángulo por el largo da los tres rectángulos.
level2.explanation: Find the two triangles: 1/2 × 16 × 15 = 120; 2 × 120 = 240 Find the three rectangles together: 16 + 17 + 17 = 50; 50 × 2.5 = 125 Add: 240 + 125 = 365
level2.explanationEs: Halla los dos triángulos: 1/2 × 16 × 15 = 120; 2 × 120 = 240 Halla los tres rectángulos juntos: 16 + 17 + 17 = 50; 50 × 2.5 = 125 Suma: 240 + 125 = 365

level2.stem: A triangular prism is 3 cm long. Each triangle end has a base of 24 cm and a height of 5 cm. The slanted sides are 13 cm. Find the surface area.
level2.stemEs: Un prisma triangular mide 3 cm de largo. Cada triángulo de los extremos tiene una base de 24 cm y una altura de 5 cm. Los lados inclinados miden 13 cm. Halla el área de superficie.
hints: Find the 2 triangles and the 3 rectangles. Then add all 5 faces.
hintsEs: Halla los 2 triángulos y los 3 rectángulos. Luego suma las 5 caras.
level2.explanation: Find the two triangles: 1/2 × 24 × 5 = 60; 2 × 60 = 120 Find the three rectangles: 24 × 3 = 72; 13 × 3 = 39; 13 × 3 = 39 Add all five faces: 120 + 72 + 39 + 39 = 270
level2.explanationEs: Halla los dos triángulos: 1/2 × 24 × 5 = 60; 2 × 60 = 120 Halla los tres rectángulos: 24 × 3 = 72; 13 × 3 = 39; 13 × 3 = 39 Suma las cinco caras: 120 + 72 + 39 + 39 = 270

level2.stem: Dev finds the surface area of a box 6 in by 4 in by 3 in with a shortcut: (6 + 4 + 6 + 4) × 3 = 60. He stops there. What is the real surface area?
level2.stemEs: Dev halla el área de superficie de una caja de 6 pulg por 4 pulg por 3 pulg con un atajo: (6 + 4 + 6 + 4) × 3 = 60. Se detiene ahí. ¿Cuál es el área de superficie real?
hints: Perimeter × height covers only the faces that go around. Which faces are missing?
hintsEs: Perímetro × altura cubre solo las caras que rodean la caja. ¿Qué caras faltan?
level2.explanation: Find the four side faces: 20 × 3 = 60 Find the top and bottom: 2 × (6 × 4) = 48 Add: 60 + 48 = 108
level2.explanationEs: Halla las cuatro caras de los lados: 20 × 3 = 60 Halla la de arriba y la de abajo: 2 × (6 × 4) = 48 Suma: 60 + 48 = 108

level2.stem: A doorstop is a triangular prism 5 cm long. Its triangle ends have sides of 9 cm, 12 cm and 15 cm. The 9 cm and 12 cm sides meet at a square corner. How much paint covers it?
level2.stemEs: Un tope de puerta es un prisma triangular de 5 cm de largo. Sus triángulos de los extremos tienen lados de 9 cm, 12 cm y 15 cm. Los lados de 9 cm y 12 cm forman una esquina cuadrada. ¿Cuánta pintura lo cubre?
hints: Paint covers all 5 faces. Use the sides at the square corner for the triangles.
hintsEs: La pintura cubre las 5 caras. Usa los lados de la esquina cuadrada para los triángulos.
level2.explanation: Find the two triangles: 1/2 × 9 × 12 = 54; 2 × 54 = 108 Find the three rectangles: 9 × 5 = 45; 12 × 5 = 60; 15 × 5 = 75 Add all five faces: 108 + 45 + 60 + 75 = 288
level2.explanationEs: Halla los dos triángulos: 1/2 × 9 × 12 = 54; 2 × 54 = 108 Halla los tres rectángulos: 9 × 5 = 45; 12 × 5 = 60; 15 × 5 = 75 Suma las cinco caras: 108 + 45 + 60 + 75 = 288

level3.stem: A rectangular prism measures 6 cm long, 4 cm wide, and 2 cm tall. What is its surface area?
choiceFeedback: That is the area of just one face, 6 times 4. Surface area totals all six faces in square units.
That counts one of each face instead of two. Every face has a matching opposite.
That is the VOLUME, 6 times 4 times 2 (it also equals only the two largest faces). Surface area totals all six faces in square units.

level3.stem: A prism is 2 cm long. Its right-triangle ends have sides of 9 cm, 12 cm and 15 cm, with the square corner between 9 cm and 12 cm. Mo uses 1/2 × 12 × 15 for each end. Find the correct surface area.
level3.stemEs: Un prisma mide 2 cm de largo. Sus extremos son triángulos rectángulos con lados de 9 cm, 12 cm y 15 cm, con la esquina cuadrada entre 9 cm y 12 cm. Mo usa 1/2 × 12 × 15 para cada extremo. Halla el área de superficie correcta.
hints: The base and height must meet at the square corner. Which side is slanted?
hintsEs: La base y la altura deben formar la esquina cuadrada. ¿Qué lado está inclinado?
level3.explanation: Find the two triangles: 1/2 × 9 × 12 = 54; 2 × 54 = 108 Find the three rectangles: (9 + 12 + 15) × 2 = 72 Add: 108 + 72 = 180
level3.explanationEs: Halla los dos triángulos: 1/2 × 9 × 12 = 54; 2 × 54 = 108 Halla los tres rectángulos: (9 + 12 + 15) × 2 = 72 Suma: 108 + 72 = 180

level3.stem: A triangular prism is 6 in long. Its triangle ends have sides of 7 in, 24 in and 25 in. The 7 in and 24 in sides meet at a square corner. Find the surface area.
level3.stemEs: Un prisma triangular mide 6 pulg de largo. Sus triángulos de los extremos tienen lados de 7 pulg, 24 pulg y 25 pulg. Los lados de 7 pulg y 24 pulg forman una esquina cuadrada. Halla el área de superficie.
hints: Use the sides at the square corner for the triangles. Use perimeter × length for the rectangles.
hintsEs: Usa los lados de la esquina cuadrada para los triángulos. Usa perímetro × largo para los rectángulos.
level3.explanation: Find the two triangles: 1/2 × 7 × 24 = 84; 2 × 84 = 168 Find the three rectangles: (7 + 24 + 25) × 6 = 336 Add: 168 + 336 = 504
level3.explanationEs: Halla los dos triángulos: 1/2 × 7 × 24 = 84; 2 × 84 = 168 Halla los tres rectángulos: (7 + 24 + 25) × 6 = 336 Suma: 168 + 336 = 504

level3.stem: A candle box is a triangular prism 10 cm long. Each end is a triangle with three 4 cm sides and a height of 3.5 cm. How much cardboard makes the box?
level3.stemEs: Una caja para velas es un prisma triangular de 10 cm de largo. Cada extremo es un triángulo con tres lados de 4 cm y una altura de 3.5 cm. ¿Cuánto cartón se usa para hacer la caja?
hints: Cardboard covers all 5 faces. The three rectangles match.
hintsEs: El cartón cubre las 5 caras. Los tres rectángulos son iguales.
level3.explanation: Find the two triangles: 1/2 × 4 × 3.5 = 7; 2 × 7 = 14 Find the three rectangles: 3 × (4 × 10) = 120 Add: 14 + 120 = 134
level3.explanationEs: Halla los dos triángulos: 1/2 × 4 × 3.5 = 7; 2 × 7 = 14 Halla los tres rectángulos: 3 × (4 × 10) = 120 Suma: 14 + 120 = 134

level3.stem: A triangular prism has triangle ends with a base of 10 cm and a height of 12 cm. The slanted sides are 13 cm. Its surface area is 480 square centimeters. How long is the prism?
level3.stemEs: Un prisma triangular tiene triángulos en los extremos con una base de 10 cm y una altura de 12 cm. Los lados inclinados miden 13 cm. Su área de superficie es 480 centímetros cuadrados. ¿Cuánto mide de largo el prisma?
hints: Take away the two triangles first. Then divide what is left by the perimeter of the triangle.
hintsEs: Primero quita los dos triángulos. Luego divide lo que queda entre el perímetro del triángulo.
level3.explanation: Find the two triangles: 1/2 × 10 × 12 = 60; 2 × 60 = 120 Find the rectangles' area: 480 − 120 = 360 Divide by the perimeter: 10 + 13 + 13 = 36; 360 ÷ 36 = 10
level3.explanationEs: Halla los dos triángulos: 1/2 × 10 × 12 = 60; 2 × 60 = 120 Halla el área de los rectángulos: 480 − 120 = 360 Divide entre el perímetro: 10 + 13 + 13 = 36; 360 ÷ 36 = 10
